title: Canonical inverse-evaluation class and its pullback equations
statement: For schemes $S,Y$, a morphism $h:Y\to S$, an abelian etale sheaf $G$ on $Y$, $q\in\mathbf N$, and an etale $V\to S$, let $c$ be the evaluation comparison of [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map]. For $x$ in the restricted cohomology group of [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology], define its raw class by $c^{-1}(x)$, using [lem-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-is-iso]. Evaluation of this class equals $x$. For every commuting triangle and coefficient map as in [lem-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-naturality], the raw pullback of this class is the inverse-evaluation class of the restricted cohomology pullback. The inverse is uniquely determined, rather than chosen from mere existence.

source.place: Second proof, canonical comparison square; evaluation uses Tag 03Q8.

proof.text: Define the raw class as the inverse of the specified evaluation isomorphism. The inverse-hom identity proves that evaluation recovers the original class. Its inverse is unique, so this construction chooses no arbitrary representative.

Apply naturality of evaluation to that inverse class and substitute the inverse-hom identity. This proves rawRestrictedCohomologyClass_map. Evaluation at the target is injective because it is an isomorphism; applying this injectivity proves rawRestrictedCohomologyClass_naturality. These arguments work in degree zero and on empty test objects.

proof_origin.place: Second proof, canonical comparison square for the affine inverse-limit argument.
